title: career-sprint-1on1-scratch-devon-jan16-2028
content:
Purpose: quick prep for 1:1 with report (Mina) — focus on next 90-day career sprint, unblockers, and a short list of measurable bets. Keep conversational, bring examples, ask directional Qs.

Context notes (from prior 1:1s):
- Mina promoted from IC3 to IC4 last cycle; excited about owning infra reliability area but bandwidth limited.
- She volunteered to lead the small-slo project but ramp slowed by infra work and oncall fatigue.
- Manager ask: help Mina translate "ownership" into visible outcomes (metrics + PRs) and reduce fire-drill load.

Agenda (30m)
- 0–3m: quick personal check-in (wellbeing, energy, oncall load)
- 3–10m: progress highlights since last 1:1 (3 wins, 1 risk)
- 10–20m: 90-day sprint framing — what success looks like, candidate deliverables, dependencies
- 20–27m: skills + exposure — what stretch looks like (architecture reviews, cross-team syncs)
- 27–30m: commitments & action items (clear owners + due dates)

Prep bullets to surface in convo:
- Wins: landed hotfix for cache-invalidation (PR #987), led postmortem blameless write-up, demoed KV-prefix cache idea in team sync.
- Risk: sustained oncall load is pulling weekly focus down ~25% (she reports losing deep work days).
- Metrics to aim for: reduce outage MTTR by 15% for serving-runtime routes in Q1; decrease tail-latency (p99) for small models by 10%; deliver end-to-end tests for cache warm-up flow.

Proposed 90-day sprint (candidate deliverables):
1) Small-SLO pilot: design doc + canary rollout plan + one-week canary (owner: Mina) — target: demo to SRE + product by Feb 28
2) Cache warm-up tests: automated integration tests + runbook (owner: Mina + teammate Ravi) — target: Feb 14 initial PR
3) Cross-team architecture review slot: lead review for model routing change and present tradeoffs (owner: Mina) — schedule by Mar 10

Skills/exposure asks (stretch opportunities):
- Ask for Mina to co-present Q1 progress at eng-all (visibility)
- Pair her with a senior architect (Aisha) for design reviews to level up system design language
- Encourage ownership of a small oncall rotation change proposal (policy + runbook)

Constraints & dependencies to call out in 1:1:
- Need 0.5 FTE from infra infra-scheduling (ticket INF-4821) for benchmarking kernels; if not granted, push timeline 4 weeks
- Dedicated test cluster availability depends on release-engineering; status unknown — ask Ravi to escalate if not in two weeks

Conversation prompts (open-ended)
- If you had a guaranteed 5 uninterrupted hours/week for the next 8 weeks what would you prioritize and why?
- Which examples of your recent work should we highlight in the promotion dossier? Concrete PRs, incidents, or architect notes?
- Are there micro-habits we can try to protect deep work (e.g., meeting freeze on Tues mornings, oncall shift swaps)?

Calibration notes for me (manager):
- Avoid promising headcount or guaranteed infra time; focus on tradeoffs and timeline transparency
- Push for measurable success criteria (don’t accept vague "more ownership")
- Offer 2 tactical ways to reduce oncall load this quarter: a) swap-week pilot with Bangalore team for night coverage; b) temporary rotation backfill (contractor) for 6 weeks — explore both in parallel

Action items (clear owners + dates):
action_items: Mina: Draft small-SLO design doc (outline + success metrics) — due 2028-02-03
Devon: Ping infra-scheduling on INF-4821 and share cost/benefit blurb — due 2028-01-20
Ravi: Spin up test namespace and initial infra quota request for cache warm-up tests — due 2028-01-30
Mina + Aisha: Set 1-hour pairing session for architecture review prep — schedule by 2028-01-25
Devon: Propose oncall swap pilot to SRE lead and draft temporary rota — due 2028-01-22
notes_followup:
After meeting: send recap email to Mina with the sprint artifacts linked (design doc template + example PRs). Add the agreed success metrics to Mina's 90-day doc in Confluence. Track progress in weekly check-ins; escalate infra blockers on day 7 if no progress. Keep conversation flexible: if Mina prefers a narrower scope, adjust deliverables to 1 major pilot + 1 test harness.

Quick scratch ideas to test later:
- Two-week "deep work" sprints with zero internal meetings for Mina to batch work
- Buddy system: pair Mina with a rotation buddy who handles first responder duties for 2 evenings/week
- Measurement: add a tiny "owner impact" tag to PRs to make ownership visible in release notes

Slack refs: #platform-release (thread: "cache-warmup-idea"), DMs: @mina (left a note about scheduling), PM: @kevin-leung for small-slo priority check.

Self-reflection prompt (for manager growth): how did I advocate for concrete resources in last cycle vs. promises? Aim to be sharper and faster in resourcing asks.
